camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeAuditRecords --region cn-hangzhou --QueryKeywords maxclients --PageSize 30 --EndTime '2019-03-25T12:10:00Z' --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --PageNumber 1 --NodeId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0' --DatabaseName 0 --StartTime '2019-03-24T12:10:00Z' --HostAddress '127.0.0.1' --AccountName demo
description_en: Queries the audit logs of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的审计日志
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-audit-records --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --node-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0 --account-name demo --database-name 0 --query-keywords maxclients --host-address 127.0.0.1 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --start-time 2019-03-24T12:10:00Z --end-time 2019-03-25T12:10:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAuditRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node in the instance. You can set this parameter to query the monitoring data of a specified node.



This parameter is available only for read/write splitting and cluster instances.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html operation to query node IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例中的节点ID。传入本参数可查询指定节点的监控信息。

当实例的架构为读写分离或集群架构时，本参数才可用。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html接口查询节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the account. If you do not specify this parameter, all accounts of the instance are queried
parameters.help_zh: 账号名称，默认（不填任何值）表示查询所有账号
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the database in the instance. If you do not specify this parameter, all databases are queried. Valid values: 0 to 255. 0 specifies database 0
parameters.help_zh: 实例中的Database，默认（不填任何值）表示查询所有DB，取值为0 ~ 255，示例0表示DB 0
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The keyword based on which the audit logs are queried. You can specify a command as a keyword to query logs. By default, all commands are queried.

You can specify only a single keyword in each call
parameters.help_zh:
根据指定的命令查询审计日志，默认查询所有执行过的命令。

只能传入单个关键词
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client. If you do not specify this parameter, this call applies to all clients
parameters.help_zh: 客户端IP，默认（不填任何值）为查询所有地址
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的最大记录数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

We recommend that you specify a time range of 10 minutes or less because audit logs contain a great number of entries. Do not specify a time range that is longer than one day
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 由于审计日志的条目数较多，一般查询的时间范围建议在10分钟以内，最长不超过1天
parameters.name: end_time
